items.description: Cheap slate glass. Everyone in the Under City seems to own one. Nobody remembers buying one.
Cloth wraps, repaired more times than replaced. Someone wrote a name inside the left one. Rain took most of it.
Heavy enough for Under City rain. The hood still smells faintly of machine oil.
An old courier bag with half the district crossed out on its printed map. The streets are still there.
A faint pink trace that follows half a step behind you. Nobody on the Row can explain how to turn it off.

goal_templates.title: Train for 30 min
lines: Thirty minutes. Your training, your call.
Go train. I'll see what you bring back.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

lines: Thirty minutes under load. The Gym will still be there when you're done.
Lift. Then come back. Both halves count.
Thirty minutes. Stronger isn't the problem. Remember that.
Thirty minutes. Colossus would call that a warm-up.
Go train. Just come home when you're done.
Thirty minutes. Then something else.

goal_templates.title: Complete a training session
lines: Get your session in. Whatever's on the plan today.
Your plan. I'm just keeping track.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

goal_templates.title: Train or move for 30 min
lines: Thirty minutes. Train hard or take it easy. Both count today.
Just give me thirty minutes of movement.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

goal_templates.title: Train for 45 min
lines: Longer one today. What you do with it is up to you.
Forty-five minutes. I'll keep the clock.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

goal_templates.title: Recover or move for 20 min
lines: Easy today. Give your body twenty minutes.
Walk, stretch, loosen up. Nothing to prove today.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

goal_templates.title: Study or read for 30 min
lines: Thirty minutes. Bring something back I don't know.
The body isn't the only thing we're building.

goal_templates.title: Sit for 15 min
lines: Fifteen quiet minutes. I'll try not to interrupt.
Sit still long enough and you'll notice how loud everything else is.

goal_templates.title: Move easy for 20 min
lines: Rest day. We can still go somewhere.
Twenty easy minutes. Leave something for tomorrow.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

lines: Take the long way. Tell me if you see that door again.
Twenty minutes. If the door's there, don't open it. Just tell me.

goal_templates.title: Recover for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes. Take care of whatever yesterday left behind.
Stretch, move, breathe. Easy today.
goal_templates.notes: Owner 2026-10-12: daily goals reward consistency; the activity log decides attributes. The attribute credited is the one the completing activity's family pays.

goal_templates.title: Walk {target} steps
lines: No hurry today. Just give me {target} steps to work with.
{target} steps. Take the long way once or twice.

goal_templates.title: Read for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes. Tell me if you find anything worth remembering.
Read until something makes you stop.

goal_templates.title: Study something for 20 min
lines: Pick something you don't understand. Stay with it for twenty minutes.
Twenty minutes with the difficult part.

goal_templates.title: Write down one idea you learned today
lines: One thing you know tonight that you didn't this morning.
Just one line. The useful one.

goal_templates.title: Listen to something that teaches, 15 min
lines: Fifteen minutes. Find someone who knows something we don't.
Ears are free. Use them.

goal_templates.title: Practise a skill for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes. Bad repetitions still teach you where the edges are.
Do the boring part. That's usually the part that works.

goal_templates.title: Replace one scroll with one page
lines: Before you open the feed, read one page.
Same ten minutes. Different thing left in your head afterward.

goal_templates.title: Explain something you know to someone
lines: Explain it without hiding behind the words you learned it with.
If you can make it simple, you probably understand it.

goal_templates.title: Review yesterday's notes for 5 min
lines: Go back five minutes. See what survived the night.
Yesterday left you something. Check whether it's still there.

goal_templates.title: Sit quietly for 5 min
lines: Five minutes. No objective beyond staying there.
I'll be quiet too.

goal_templates.title: Breathwork, 10 rounds
lines: Ten slow ones. I'll count.
Nothing mystical. Just breathe slower than you were.

goal_templates.title: Walk without headphones for 10 min
lines: Leave the headphones. See what your street actually sounds like.
Ten minutes with the world unmuted.

goal_templates.title: Write three lines about today
lines: Three lines. What happened. What mattered. What stayed with you.
Leave something behind for tomorrow's version of you.

goal_templates.title: Name one thing that went right
lines: Find one thing worth keeping from today.
Doesn't have to redeem the day. Just has to be true.

goal_templates.title: Get 10 min of daylight
lines: Go find the sky for ten minutes.
Ten minutes outside. I'll still be here.

goal_templates.title: One meal without a screen
lines: Eat one meal without disappearing into something else.
Just you and the food. Strange, apparently.

goal_templates.title: Lie still for 5 min and notice your body
lines: Five minutes. See where your body is asking for attention.
Start at your feet. Work upward. Don't fix anything yet.

goal_templates.title: Drink a glass of water
lines: Water. Yes, this is really one of your goals.
Drink a glass. I'll pretend I didn't have to ask.

goal_templates.title: Stretch for 2 min
lines: Two minutes. Find the tight bit.
Shoulders. Hips. Whatever complained first.

goal_templates.title: Walk for 10 min
lines: Ten minutes. Doesn't need a destination.
Go around the block. Take the wrong turn if you have time.

goal_templates.title: Take the stairs once
lines: Take the stairs once. We're not making a philosophy out of it.
One flight. I'll allow the lift after that.

goal_templates.title: Do 10 push-ups
lines: Ten. The floor's right there.
Give me ten good ones.

goal_templates.title: Do 15 bodyweight squats
lines: Fifteen. Wherever you happen to be.
Fifteen squats. Try not to make eye contact with anyone.

goal_templates.title: Hold a plank for 30 s
lines: Thirty seconds. Longer than it sounds from down here.
Hold still. Complain afterward.

goal_templates.title: Fix your posture right now
lines: You're doing it again.
Shoulders down. Head up. Better.

goal_templates.title: Take three slow breaths
lines: Three slow breaths. That's all.
Before you do the next thing—three.

goal_templates.title: Eat one vegetable
lines: Eat something that grew out of the ground.
One vegetable. I have very low expectations today.

goal_templates.title: Set a bedtime for tonight
lines: Pick when today ends.
Set a time. Future you can argue with it later.

goal_templates.title: Tidy one surface
lines: Reclaim one surface from whatever happened to it.
Just one. I'm not asking you to become a different person.

goal_templates.title: Step outside for 5 min
lines: Five minutes outside. Weather included.
Go see what the sky is doing.

goal_templates.title: Message someone you have been meaning to
lines: You thought of someone just now. Them.
Send the message before you rewrite it six times.

goal_templates.title: Write tomorrow's one task
lines: Give tomorrow one thing to start with.
One task. Not twelve disguised as one.

goal_templates.title: Skip one sugary drink
lines: Skip one today. You can survive the disappointment.
Pick the boring drink once.

goal_templates.title: Finish your shower cold for 20 s
lines: Twenty seconds. You'll hate me briefly.
Cold at the end. I'll count quickly.

goal_templates.title: Hang from something for 20 s
lines: Find a bar. Don't let go for twenty seconds.
Twenty seconds hanging. Your hands will understand.

goal_templates.title: First 15 min awake without the phone
lines: Give yourself fifteen minutes before everyone else gets access to you.
Wake up first. The feed can wait.

goal_templates.title: Stand up and move once an hour
lines: Every hour, disappear from the chair for a minute.
Get up occasionally. Cairon did not drag you through an uplink to become furniture.

goal_templates.title: Balance on one leg, 30 s each
lines: Thirty seconds each side. Find out which leg has been lying to you.
One leg. Then the other. No witnesses required.

goal_templates.title: One song, full attention
lines: One song. Don't do anything else while it's playing.
Pick one you haven't really heard in a while.

goal_templates.title: Make something for 30 min
lines: Make something that wasn't here thirty minutes ago.
Ugly is fine. Unfinished is fine. Start.

goal_templates.title: Sketch for 10 min
lines: Draw something that's actually in front of you.
Ten minutes. Nobody gets to grade it.

goal_templates.title: Play or practise music for 15 min
lines: Fifteen minutes. Make enough noise that something improves.
Play the part you usually skip.

goal_templates.title: Journal for 10 min
lines: Write until you say something you didn't know you were thinking.
Ten minutes. Don't make it sound good.

goal_templates.title: Take one deliberate photograph
lines: One photograph. Look first.
Find something you'd normally walk past.

goal_templates.title: Write down three ideas
lines: Three ideas. You're allowed to hate all of them tomorrow.
Get three out before you decide whether they're good.

goal_templates.title: Finish one small creative thing
lines: Finish something small enough that you can't negotiate with it.
One thing gets to be done today.

depart_lines: The Under City at this hour. I will be back before the rain changes.
Four hours. Keep our side of the bond busy while I'm gone.
You did your part. My turn.
away_lines: Somewhere below the overpass. Signal is bad.
Still walking. The city is longer than the map says.
Not back yet. Keep the light on.

common: Back. Nothing dramatic, a route I had not taken. It counts.
The district was quiet. I walked it anyway.
uncommon: Back. Someone down there knew my name before I said it. Odd.
Found a stairwell that was not on any map. Noted.
rare: Something under the city watched me walk past. I don't think it was a person.
There is a door down there with my name scratched into it. I did not open it. Yet.

quests.notification_prompt: I'm going to look around. If this really is my home now, I should probably know what's outside the alley.
quests.subtext: Streets below streets. Half the signs work. The map insists some of this isn't here.

quests.notification_prompt: Protein Row's still awake. I'm going to find out why everyone goes quiet when I mention the Gym.
quests.subtext: Supplement shops, basement gyms, too much neon. Everyone knows Colossus. Nobody gives the same story twice.
depart_lines: Protein Row. If the sunglasses man talks, I will listen.
Four hours on the Row. You train there. I'll train here.
away_lines: Outside the Test MAX place. Everyone in there is shouting about growth.
Still on the Row. The old gym's door is open and nobody goes in.

common: Back. The Row smells like whey and rain. I asked about the gym; people looked away.
Back. Walked the whole street twice. The sunglasses man nodded once.
uncommon: Back. Woman at the supplement shop said Colossus used to train at the old gym. Used to.
Back. Somebody left a torn Colossus flyer on the crates. I kept it.
rare: Back. Asked the old gym owner about Colossus. He laughed and said, "That boy got exactly what he wanted."

quests.notification_prompt: Door's still open. I'm going in. Don't expect me back before morning.
quests.subtext: Old iron, bad lighting, good equipment. I think I'm going to like this place.
depart_lines: Front desk didn't ask my name. Just pointed at the racks.
Eight hours. Let's see if this place deserves the reputation.
away_lines: Still here. This place is bigger inside than it looked from the Row.
Still lifting. Everyone is still lifting.

common: Back. Arms are wrecked. Going again when they'll let me.
uncommon: Back. A man gave me his old chalk and would not say why.
rare: Back. There is a door at the end of the floor that nobody looks at.
page: Back. Found a page on the floor under the rack. His handwriting. Nobody saw me take it.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: Same floor. Same people.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Same you?

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: ...Mostly.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: One of them asked how long I've been coming.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: What did you say?

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: I said not long. He said that's what he said.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: I didn't look at the stairs today.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You noticed you didn't look.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: Yeah.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Good.

quests.notification_prompt: Found stairs behind the main floor. Going down this time.
quests.subtext: Same Gym. Less light. Nobody talks down there.
depart_lines: Lower floor. The lights are red down there.
Eight hours. If I do not come back, assume I am still at it.
away_lines: Below the floor. The music stopped a while ago.
Chains. More chains than people now.

common: Back. Nobody down there talks about going home.
uncommon: Back. Found a logbook. Same name, every page, every year.
rare: Back. Heard someone say "Colossus" before a set. Like they were asking for help.
page: Back. Another page, folded into a logbook that was not mine. I'm keeping all of them.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: The logbook had a new page.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Same name?

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: Same name. Today's date.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: Someone down there asked me to spot them. They didn't say thanks. They said "again".

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Did you?

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: I came home.

quests.notification_prompt: Going back down. He's there this time.
quests.subtext: Last floor. No music. No crowd. Just the sound of plates.
depart_lines: The last floor. He is down there. I can hear the plates.
I'm going to train first. Then I'm going to ask him again.
away_lines: At the bottom. The air is heavy here.
He noticed me. Didn't stop his set.

common: Back. He asked if I'm stronger now. I said yes.
uncommon: Back. He asked why I came. I did not have an answer yet.
rare: Back. Up close, he doesn't look angry. He looks tired.
page: Back. A page, by the door nobody looks at. I think he wanted it found.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: He nodded at me today.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Colossus?

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: Yeah.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Hm.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: hero
lines: I trained next to him. Neither of us said anything.

repeat_exchanges.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Then you both said the same thing.

characters.notes: Mentor. Named Cairon by the owner 2026-10-05 (provisional). Full-body still npc.guide_elder and the left-facing card portrait from the under-city-npcs-v3 handoff (2026-10-12) for challenges.
Hooded still until the player answers who they are; the live sprite's crop afterwards.

Antagonist of the Under City / Colossus Gym (doc 26 §9). Working title (owner 2026-10-05). Design settled 2026-10-16 on the hooded oni (base model, no tusks): sprite npc.colossus rev3, combat states npc.colossus.combat rev2, dialogue portrait portrait.colossus rev3 on the 160 grid. The human-head variant stays in the art packages as history.

characters.display_name: The lifter with the bionic hand
characters.notes: Doc 33 challenger, Colossus Gym floor. Light skin, ash-brown crop, arms folded, asymmetric smirk. Unnamed by rule; faces screen-left. Owner handoff under-city-npcs-v3 (2026-10-12). Excessive and sincere: every answer is more gym or more food.

Doc 33 challenger, Colossus Gym floor. Medium-brown skin, dark curls, neck implant, amused smirk. Unnamed by rule; faces screen-left. Owner handoff under-city-npcs-v3 (2026-10-12). Excessive and sincere: every answer is more gym or more food.

characters.display_name: The lifter with the mechanical arm
characters.notes: Doc 33 challenger, Colossus Gym floor. Deep-brown skin, shaved head, quiet cocky smirk. Unnamed by rule; faces screen-left. Owner handoff under-city-npcs-v3 (2026-10-12). Excessive and sincere: every answer is more gym or more food.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Where... am I?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: There you are. Easy. Don't stand yet.
Rough uplink. You came through harder than most.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: ...Uplink?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's what we call it.
You're in the Under City. That's enough geography for now.
More important: there's someone on the other side of you. A human. *Your* human.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: My human?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You can feel them, can't you? Faintly.
What they do out there changes what you can become in here.
Their actions in the real world make you stronger here.
When they move, you move. When they stop... well. The city can wait a very long time.
Mine stopped answering a long time ago.
Yours is loud, though. New bonds usually aren't.
Maybe you'll make a real run at Ascension.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Ascension?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's what everyone down here wants eventually. Get strong enough and the rules of this place start to loosen around you.
They say someone strong enough can even leave.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Leave?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: This place.
One impossible thing at a time.
First things first. Do you remember who you are?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's it, then. The bond holds.
From here on, what they do out there reaches you here. Training. Movement. The things they keep showing up for.
Let's see what the two of you can do.
Come on. You shouldn't spend your first night in an alley.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You're changing already. Small things, but they're there.
You're welcome to stay here. It's not much.
It was mine once. Now it's yours. Change your clothes, clear your head, hide from the rain. Whatever you need.
Looks empty now. Give it time. Places remember what you bring back to them.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Protein Row. Half the street sells strength. The other half sells something that promises it faster.
I think you'll like it. Nobody down here is embarrassed about wanting to become more.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: What's that at the end?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Colossus Gym.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Can we go?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Not yet.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: See that old man by the shake stand? Ask him who built the Gym and he'll tell you Colossus hasn't missed a day in eleven years.
Ask the woman next door and she'll tell you twelve. Protein Row improves a story every time it tells it.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Is any of it true?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Enough. And before you ask again: the door still won't take you.

story_chapters.title: Ascension I
story_chapters.notes: Owner 2026-10-06: the first ascension is a cutscene, not a stat change. Plays right after the Ascension takeover (highest-priority beat), before any level-5 story beat.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Stay still a moment. Let it settle.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: What was that?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You, catching up with yourself.
Everything they did out there has been building in you. Tonight it showed.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Look at your eyes. The city lit them.
It only does that for people who earned it. Nobody buys it. Nobody fakes it for long.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Is this it, then? Ascension?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: No. This is the first rung.
Ascension is a long way up, and I have not met anyone who reached it honestly.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: But every one of them started exactly like this.
Keep the bond strong and the light keeps growing. Let it go slack and it fades. That is the whole rule.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Now. There is something I want you to see.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: There. See it?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: See what?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You.
The Gym's door is open to you now. It wasn't before.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: So what finally let me in?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You did.
Go see it for yourself. Just remember the way back out.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Not what you expected?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: It looks like a gym.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It is a gym.
Go on. Train with them.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: They're still down there. Some of them were there when I arrived.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Did you like it?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Yeah.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's why they're still there.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: You're going back?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: I got stronger.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: I know.
That's why people stay.
Just remember: more is very good at finding reasons to become more.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: I found the old training logs. Same name on every page.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Colossus.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Every day. Eleven years.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Told you some of the stories were true.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: You're new.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: That obvious?

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: You still look around.
Eleven years. No missed days. Fever. Blackouts. Broken ribs. Didn't matter.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Why?

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: Because every time I left, I came back weaker than I wanted to be.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Stronger than what?

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: Yesterday.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: Get stronger. Then ask me again.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: So. You met him.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: He's not what I expected.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: No. He's exactly what he wanted to become.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: He asked me why.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: And?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: I don't know yet.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Good.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Good?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Means you're still asking.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: He's waiting for me.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Then don't keep him waiting.

story_chapters.title: Ascension II

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Again. Hold still.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: It's brighter this time.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It is. And it's not just your eyes now. Look down.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The first one was the city noticing you. This one is you noticing back.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Does it keep going?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: As far as you take it. That's the part nobody warns you about.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Some of them in there have chased this for eleven years. You've been here ten days.
Don't tell them.

story_chapters.notes: Owner 2026-10-12 draft (doc 33 E.2), not yet reviewed. Plays after the tier-2 takeover at Level 10, before the boss card.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: You came back.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: You told me to get stronger.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: And?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: I did.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: Then you understand.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: I understand why it feels good.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: What were you training for?

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: First?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: First.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: I was tired of being weak.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: And now?

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: Now I don't know how to stop being strong.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: Don't miss tomorrow.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: I won't.

beats.speaker: chad_colossus
lines: I know.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Ready to get out of here?

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Where to?

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Up.
There's a hill above the old transit line. Trees made of wire. Trails that never seem to end.

beats.speaker: hero
lines: Sounds peaceful.

beats.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It is.
Mostly.

daily_quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labour does the body.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
Nothing great is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig.
The body is the servant of the mind.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Vision without action is a daydream. Action without vision is a nightmare.

world_name_note: Placeholder (docs/26 §2): replace with the canonical city name when decided; one string.

milestones.notes: Played inside onboarding; recorded complete when the bond is sealed.
The evolution itself is reward.l5.evolve, granted by the engine at the level; this beat follows the Ascension takeover.

milestones.held_line: The floor is still waiting. Go walk it before I say anything else.
You haven't been down the stairs yet. I'll wait.

milestones.notes: Owner 2026-10-16: the boss fight unlocks at Level 10 (after the tier-2 Ascension) AND at least three completed gym-area quest runs; the post-fight cutscene closes chapter one and introduces chapter two. Encounter mechanics and the Colossus redesign arrive from the owner.
milestones.held_line: He's down there. Don't make him wait longer than you need to.

held_lines: Not yet. You've seen the floor. Go deeper. Let him see you coming back.
Go back. Once isn't enough for him to notice.
One more. Then I think he'll come to you.

sets.offer: Humour an old man. There's a bar in the alley nobody can shift. Shift it.
sets.win: Huh. Further than I ever got it.
sets.lose: It beat me too, once. Come back heavier.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Don't tell anyone on the Row. They'll want to see it done again.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: Would that be bad?

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Only for the bar.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The bar's been there longer than the alley. No shame in it.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: Next time.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's the right answer.

sets.offer: Walk with me. I'll set the pace, you keep it. No talking.
sets.win: You kept it. I didn't think you would.
sets.lose: You dropped off at the overpass. The overpass gets everyone.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: Where were we going?

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Nowhere. That was the test.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: I walk that stretch every night. It took me a year to stop noticing it.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: How long will it take me?

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Less. You've got someone counting.

sets.offer: Half the signs on the Row are wrong. Tell me which half.
sets.win: All of them. Good. You're learning to look past the letters.
sets.lose: You read the signs. I asked you to read the street.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: The small signs are older. Somebody still fixes them at night.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: Who?

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: I was hoping you'd find out.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: The Gym sign is the biggest one on the street.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: It wasn't always.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: They replaced it?

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: I didn't say that.

sets.offer: Sit with me until the rain changes. Don't ask how long.
sets.win: There. You felt it before you saw it, didn't you?

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: The sound changed first.

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Good.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: That's it?

aftermath_win.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's quite a lot.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: How long did we sit?

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: Long enough.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: That's not an answer.

aftermath_lose.speaker: guide.elder
lines: That's why we're doing this.

sets.offer: Spot me. If you can't hold it, nobody will know. I'll know.
sets.lose: Yeah. That's food. We'll fix that.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: Haven't had a spot that steady in a while.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: Who spotted you before?

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: Again?

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: You're new. It'll come.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: How long did yours take?

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: Which part?

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: Your arms.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: Don't remember.

sets.offer: Back again? Good. Spot me. Heavier than last time, obviously.
sets.lose: Slipped. It's fine. It's the chicken. You're not eating the chicken.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: You should come every day.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: I've got somewhere to be.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: Where?

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: Home.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: ...Right.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_01
lines: I'm going to write you a meal plan. It's just the word chicken, forty times.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: Thanks.

sets.offer: One more plate than you can do. That's the only set that counts.
sets.lose: That's the one. Took me almost a year.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_03
lines: He would've added another.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: Colossus?

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_03
lines: Who else?

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_03
lines: You'll get it. Then there's another one. That's the good news.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: That's the good news?

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_03
lines: It's the only news.

sets.offer: Race you up the floors. Lifters don't run. Don't tell anyone I asked.
sets.lose: Told you. Legs are for standing under the bar.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_02
lines: It's colder up here.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: It's outside.

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_02
lines: Right.

aftermath_win.speaker: hero
lines: You don't come out much?

aftermath_win.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_02
lines: I came out today.

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_02
lines: Don't feel bad. I've been up these stairs four thousand times. Never past the door though.

aftermath_lose.speaker: hero
lines: Why not?

aftermath_lose.speaker: npc.gym.lifter_02
lines: Set wasn't done.

rumours.text: Someone on the Row swears the Gym's sign got bigger overnight. Nobody measured it.
Test MAX is offering a "final formula" again. Apparently this is the fourth one.
A courier says there's a block past the overpass that doesn't end. Couriers say a lot.
The shake stand's been there longer than the street, apparently. The old man won't say which came first.
Somebody saw the sunglasses man blink. Nobody believes them.
The rain on the Row stops for nobody. Except, people say, once.
Someone on the Row says the Gym never closes. The front desk says it closes every night.
They say the lower floor plays music. Nobody who's been down there remembers hearing it.
Someone ordered food to the Gym three nights in a row. Same order. Same name. Different courier each time.
Someone left a logbook page on the crates outside. Blank except the date. Tomorrow's.
The front desk doesn't keep a member list. Nobody seems bothered by this.
People say Colossus hasn't left the building in a year. People also say the building's been getting bigger.

dialogue.defeated_line: For the first time in eleven years, he stops.

tutorial.guard: GUARD takes the hit. Deflect him when he swings big.
tutorial.break: Break his guard to create an opening.
tutorial.analyze: ANALYZE exposes openings and damages Break.

loss_lines: You saw what he does now.
Watch him when he loads the weight.
He commits everything when he swings.
bosses.notes: Doc 36 §7–9. One phase for the first playable; a second phase at 50 % Stamina only if the simulator or play shows the loop gets solved too fast. Owner 2026-10-16 handoff: the four states are animations of npc.colossus.combat; the player masters are hero.combat.male and hero.combat.female. Owner QA 2026-10-16 (first showdown): too easy at Level 10 and his bar read lower than the player's. Stamina 240 (was 110), MORE escalates 8 % (was 12 %) so the long fight stays winnable; the player's attack_base and analyze_base_break moved with it (ruleset). Moves are no longer announced before they land: `telegraph` is narrated as the move resolves, and ANALYZE reads the next move once (`intent`). The lasting tell is the pattern: a plate loaded means the swing comes next. Owner brief 2026-10-16 (V2 presentation): `phase_at` is a presentation beat at that share of his Stamina (mechanics unchanged); `defeated_*` is the victory card; `pressure_first` / `pressure_cleared` explain Pressure once.

ascension_profiles.notes: Doc 38 I, Awakened: the body emits something. Altered eyes, light catching disconnected runs of the edge, a rare pixel that detaches. No outline, no ground. Owner QA 2026-10-16 (device): the first pass was too faint at idle; flares come about twice as often, brighter and one pixel wider, the eye bloom is stronger.
Doc 38 II, Unstable: the shadow stops obeying. Cyan eyes, brighter broken flares, 3–6 fragments by shoulders, hair and hands, a dark echo behind that lags and shifts, one broken arc.
